en.baptism: On 12 December 1905, in the Plungė Roman Catholic parish church, Fr. Bajorinas baptised an infant named Apominary with all the rites of the Sacrament.
en.parents: Son of Ivan, son of Isatei, and Anna née Yankovskaia, Stakanis, lawfully married peasants of Plungė district, born on 11 December 1905 in the village of Keklital of this parish.
en.godparents: The godparents were Dominik Zhutovt and Varvara, wife of Ksaver Nugaris.
